# Refactoring for Codex

Generated by scripts/build-targets.mjs from plugins/refactoring/ in the guided-plugins repository.

- Skills: 30 workflow and rule skills plus 6 mode skills, invoked as `$refactoring:<name>` or from `/skills`.
- Subagents: 22 roles in `../agents/refactoring-*.toml`. Codex plugins cannot bundle subagents, so install them with `node scripts/install-codex-agents.mjs refactoring`.
- Always-on rules: see `../../rules/refactoring/`.

Full instructions: docs/AGENTS_SUPPORT.md in the repository.
